title: parrya olgae
intro: Parrya olgae, commonly known as the alpine parsnip, is a plant species belonging to the family Brassicaceae. It is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine. The therapeutic actions of Parrya olgae are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antimicrobial activity, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Parrya olgae include glucosinolates and other secondary metabolites, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
